narrative.headline: Engine and electrical gripes lead 2018 Malibu owner complaints
narrative.summary: From 685 owner reports to NHTSA, engine trouble is by far the most common, named in 40% of complaints, with electrical issues next at 27%. Drivetrain and acceleration problems show up too: power train (25%), vehicle speed control (16%), and the fuel/propulsion system (12%). Most reports are about reliability rather than safety, but a handful involved fires (1 engine, 2 electrical) or crashes, so the details below are worth a read.
